name: Framering
description: A frame with a disc standing in the opening, in a second ink.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0 62%, transparent 62%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0 62%, transparent 62%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
